dialogues.jp:
休みとなると、街中をぶらついている俺は、も
しかして寂しい人間なんだろうか。
dialogues.en:
With nothing to do, shuffling down the street alone, had
quite a lonely feel to it...
dialogues.text:
With nothing to do, shuffling down the street alone, had
quite a lonely feel to it...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君だ。こんにちは──って」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun! Good afterno--"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun! Good afterno--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ。な、何で泣いてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Wa, wah! Are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "Wa, wah! Are you crying?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はは、この東京砂漠で君に出会えた事が嬉し
　くてな」
dialogues.en:
"Hahah, meeting you here in this desert of Japan has lifted
my spirits!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahah, meeting you here in this desert of Japan has lifted
my spirits!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん〜……？　春のせい？」
dialogues.en: "Mm~....? Spring hallucinations?"
dialogues.text: "Mm~....? Spring hallucinations?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「微妙に失礼な事言うな……」
dialogues.en: "That's kinda rude..."
dialogues.text: "That's kinda rude..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君って、たまに本気だか冗談だか分から
　ないんだよね」
dialogues.en:
"I can't tell right now whether you're joking or being
serious."
dialogues.text:
"I can't tell right now whether you're joking or being
serious."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さらに失礼な。俺はいつだって冗談だ」
dialogues.en: "So-rry. You know I'm always having a laugh."
dialogues.text: "So-rry. You know I'm always having a laugh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それはそれで、アレですね」
dialogues.en: "Quite true, that."
dialogues.text: "Quite true, that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それで、どうして泣いていたの？」
dialogues.en: "But anyway, why are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "But anyway, why are you crying?"

dialogues.jp:
くっと小首を傾げ、俺の目をじっと見つめてく
る。
dialogues.en: She tilted her head slightly, staring into my eyes.
dialogues.text: She tilted her head slightly, staring into my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、直前にあくびをしただけなんだけど」
dialogues.en: "I yawned just a few seconds before."
dialogues.text: "I yawned just a few seconds before."

dialogues.jp: 何かを探るようだった目が、笑いの形に崩れた。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps searching for another explanation, a bright smile
grew on her face.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps searching for another explanation, a bright smile
grew on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だ、心配して損しちゃいましたよ」
dialogues.en:
"Is that all? Heh, I was worried that you were really
sad..."
dialogues.text:
"Is that all? Heh, I was worried that you were really
sad..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もし本気で泣いていたら、慰めてくれた？」
dialogues.en: "If I was really crying, would you comfort me?"
dialogues.text: "If I was really crying, would you comfort me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "E, eh, I guess so..."
dialogues.text: "E, eh, I guess so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、やぶさかではないってところです」
dialogues.en: "To avoid any pain anyway... namely mine."
dialogues.text: "To avoid any pain anyway... namely mine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だそれは」
dialogues.en: "Psh, what's that supposed to mean."
dialogues.text: "Psh, what's that supposed to mean."

dialogues.jp:
振り上げていた拳を下ろす。もし慰めてくれる
なら、１６連射で自分の頭を殴ったのに。
dialogues.en:
I lowered my jokingly-raised hand. Although if she had said
she wouldn't, I'd probably have knocked her a bit...maybe.
dialogues.text:
I lowered my jokingly-raised hand. Although if she had said
she wouldn't, I'd probably have knocked her a bit...maybe.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何か、買い物ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you shopping?"
dialogues.text: "Are you shopping?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ただぶらぶらしてただけ。ことりは？」
dialogues.en: "Nah, just messing about. What about you?"
dialogues.text: "Nah, just messing about. What about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私は、これからちょっと友達の家に行くんで
　す」
dialogues.en: "I was heading to one of my friends' house."
dialogues.text: "I was heading to one of my friends' house."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、今度、卒業パーティーがあるじゃない
　ですか」
dialogues.en:
"You know that the graduation party is happening soon,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"You know that the graduation party is happening soon,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, yeah."

dialogues.jp:
もう、そんな季節だった。この春、俺達は付属
を卒業する。
dialogues.en:
Right, it's almost time for that. This spring, we're going
to be graduating from middle school.
dialogues.text:
Right, it's almost time for that. This spring, we're going
to be graduating from middle school.

dialogues.jp:
本校に移るだけなので、それが大きな変化と言
えるかどうかは分からないが、一つの節目では
あるだろう。
dialogues.en:
We'd be moving to the main school as well. It's not a huge
change, but it represents a major turning point in our young
lives.
dialogues.text:
We'd be moving to the main school as well. It's not a huge
change, but it represents a major turning point in our young
lives.

dialogues.jp:
「卒業に学生達でパーティーってのも、よく分
　からん学園だよな」
dialogues.en:
"I really don't understand this school though. A party for
graduation?"
dialogues.text:
"I really don't understand this school though. A party for
graduation?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですよね。普通は、もっと厳粛？　だと
　思うんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"That's true. I guess I'd expect a graduation ceremony to be
a bit more solemn..."
dialogues.text:
"That's true. I guess I'd expect a graduation ceremony to be
a bit more solemn..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、かったるい事よりは、楽しい分まだマシ
　だろうけどな」
dialogues.en: "Well, even if that's the case, I suppose it could be fun."
dialogues.text: "Well, even if that's the case, I suppose it could be fun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「これから友達の家に集まってね、それの相談
　をするんです」
dialogues.en: "We're gathering at my friend's house to discuss about it."
dialogues.text: "We're gathering at my friend's house to discuss about it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
卒業パーティーってのは、学生達におまかせの
イベントなので、やりたかったら自主的に動く
しかない。
dialogues.en:
For the graduation party, the school relies on the students
to come up with it's own events, to show them some
independency.
dialogues.text:
For the graduation party, the school relies on the students
to come up with it's own events, to show them some
independency.

dialogues.jp:
多分、そういう面白いイベントで自主性を高め
るのが教育の方針なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Or more accurately, the school's probably indirectly
teaching the students how to take their own initiative
sometimes.
dialogues.text:
Or more accurately, the school's probably indirectly
teaching the students how to take their own initiative
sometimes.

dialogues.jp: 「で、ことりは何をやんの？」
dialogues.en: "What would you guys be doing?"
dialogues.text: "What would you guys be doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それを、これから決めるんですよ。朝倉君は、
　何かやるんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"That's what we're trying to think of. What would you be
doing?"
dialogues.text:
"That's what we're trying to think of. What would you be
doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ、かったるいんで」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, sounds troublesome."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, sounds troublesome."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何かやった方が、思い出になると思いますよ」
dialogues.en: "You really should, it'd be good memories in the future."
dialogues.text: "You really should, it'd be good memories in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま。パーティー自体は、参加すると思うけど
　な」
dialogues.en:
"Well, enjoying the party should be enough for that, in my
opinion."
dialogues.text:
"Well, enjoying the party should be enough for that, in my
opinion."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私達の催しを見に来るの、忘れないで下さい
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Don't forget to see what we'd be doing, then!"
dialogues.text: "Don't forget to see what we'd be doing, then!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「サービスシーンとかがあるならな」
dialogues.en: "Will there be some fanservice scenes?"
dialogues.text: "Will there be some fanservice scenes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……センス、オヤジですよ」
dialogues.en: "...You sound like a dirty old man."
dialogues.text: "...You sound like a dirty old man."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おやじ、かぁ……」
dialogues.en: "A dirty old man, huh..."
dialogues.text: "A dirty old man, huh..."

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの卒業パーティー◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Graduation Party◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Graduation Party◆

dialogues.jp:
友達の家に行く途中だということりに出会った。
何でも、卒業パーティーでの催しについて話し
合いに行くのだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
I met Kotori while she was on her way to a friend's house.
She was going there to discuss about what to do for the
upcoming graduation party.
dialogues.text:
I met Kotori while she was on her way to a friend's house.
She was going there to discuss about what to do for the
upcoming graduation party.
